summary: Skool answers reads on the Next.js host and every mutation on a second REST host; a regen must send each endpoint to the host its spec entry names, not to the global base URL.
reason: The spec marks twelve endpoints with a per-endpoint base_url override, but the generated commands emitted the path relative to BaseURL, so every post, comment, upvote, member-moderation and notification call was sent to the read host. They do not exist there, so the whole write surface of the published CLI was unreachable.
validated_outcome: posts create --dry-run reported POST https://www.skool.com/posts before the fix and POST https://api2.skool.com/posts after it; a redirected SKOOL_BASE_URL still carries writes to the mock server.
